sitrusBerry.name: Sitrus Berry
sitrusBerry.description: Restores {{healPercent}}% HP if HP is below {{thresholdPercent}}%.

lumBerry.name: Lum Berry
lumBerry.description: Cures any non-volatile status condition and confusion.

enigmaBerry.name: Enigma Berry
enigmaBerry.description: Restores {{healPercent}}% HP if hit by a super effective move.

liechiBerry.name: Liechi Berry
liechiBerry.description: Raises Attack if HP is below {{thresholdPercent}}%.

ganlonBerry.name: Ganlon Berry
ganlonBerry.description: Raises Defense if HP is below {{thresholdPercent}}%.

petayaBerry.name: Petaya Berry
petayaBerry.description: Raises Sp. Atk if HP is below {{thresholdPercent}}%.

apicotBerry.name: Apicot Berry
apicotBerry.description: Raises Sp. Def if HP is below {{thresholdPercent}}%.

salacBerry.name: Salac Berry
salacBerry.description: Raises Speed if HP is below {{thresholdPercent}}%.

lansatBerry.name: Lansat Berry
lansatBerry.description: Raises critical hit ratio if HP is below {{thresholdPercent}}%.

starfBerry.name: Starf Berry
starfBerry.description: Sharply raises a random stat if HP is below {{thresholdPercent}}%.

leppaBerry.name: Leppa Berry
leppaBerry.description: Restores {{restorePp}} PP to a move if its PP reaches 0.

reviverSeed.name: Reviver Seed
reviverSeed.description: Revives the holder for 1/2 HP upon fainting from a direct hit.

whiteHerb.name: White Herb
whiteHerb.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It will restore any lowered stat in battle.

lightBall.name: Light Ball
lightBall.description: It’s a mysterious orb that boosts Pikachu’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

thickClub.name: Thick Club
thickClub.description: This hard bone of unknown origin boosts Cubone or Marowak’s Attack stat.

metalPowder.name: Metal Powder
metalPowder.description: Extremely fine yet hard, this odd powder boosts Ditto’s Defense stat.

quickPowder.name: Quick Powder
quickPowder.description: Extremely fine yet hard, this odd powder boosts Ditto’s Speed stat.

deepSeaScale.name: Deep Sea Scale
deepSeaScale.description: This scale shines with a faint pink and boosts Clamperl’s Sp. Def stat.

deepSeaTooth.name: Deep Sea Tooth
deepSeaTooth.description: This fang gleams a sharp silver and boosts Clamperl’s Sp. Atk stat.

scopeLens.name: Scope Lens
scopeLens.description: It’s a lens for scoping out weak points. It boosts the holder’s critical-hit ratio.

leek.name: Leek
leek.description: This very long and stiff stalk of leek boosts the critical-hit ratio of Farfetch’d’s moves.

focusBand.name: Focus Band
focusBand.description: Adds a {{chancePercent}}% chance to survive with {{hp}} HP after being damaged enough to faint.

quickClaw.name: Quick Claw
quickClaw.description: Adds a {{chancePercent}}% chance to move first regardless of speed (after priority).

kingsRock.name: King’s Rock
kingsRock.description: Adds a {{chancePercent}}% chance an attack move will cause the opponent to flinch.

leftovers.name: Leftovers
leftovers.description: Heals 1/{{healDenominator}} of a Pokémon’s maximum HP every turn.

shellBell.name: Shell Bell
shellBell.description: Heals 1/{{healDenominator}} of a Pokémon’s dealt damage.

mysticalRock.name: Mystical Rock
mysticalRock.description: Extends the duration of terrain and weather caused by the holder’s moves or Abilities by {{turns}} turns.

multiLens.name: Multi Lens
multiLens.description: Converts {{damagePercent}}% of damage from the holder’s attacks into an additional strike.

goldenPunch.name: Golden Punch
goldenPunch.description: Grants {{moneyPercent}}% of direct damage inflicted as money.

gripClaw.name: Grip Claw
gripClaw.description: Upon attacking, there is a {{chancePercent}}% chance the foe’s held item will be stolen.

toxicOrb.name: Toxic Orb
toxicOrb.description: It’s a bizarre orb that exudes toxins when touched and will badly poison the holder during battle.

flameOrb.name: Flame Orb
flameOrb.description: It’s a bizarre orb that gives off heat when touched and will affect the holder with a burn during battle.

soulDew.name: Soul Dew
soulDew.description: Increases the influence of a Pokémon’s nature on its stats by {{boostPercent}}% (additive).

baton.name: Baton
baton.description: Allows passing along effects when switching Pokémon, which also bypasses traps.

miniBlackHole.name: Mini Black Hole
miniBlackHole.description: Every turn, the holder acquires one held item from the foe.

eviolite.name: Eviolite
eviolite.description: This mysterious evolutionary lump boosts the Defense and Sp. Def stats when held by a Pokémon that can still evolve.

shuckleJuiceGood.name: Sweet Shuckle Juice
shuckleJuiceGood.description: Increases all of the holder’s base stats. You were blessed by the Shuckle.

shuckleJuiceBad.name: Foul Shuckle Juice
shuckleJuiceBad.description: Decreases all of the holder’s base stats. You were cursed by the Shuckle.

oldGateau.name: Old Gateau
oldGateau.description: Increases some of the holder’s stats.

machoBrace.name: Macho Brace
machoBrace.description: Defeating a Pokémon grants the holder a stack of it. Each stack boosts stats a bit. Bonus at max stacks.

gimmighoulEvoTracker.name: Treasures
gimmighoulEvoTracker.description: This Pokémon loves treasure! Keep collecting treasure and something might happen!

map.name: Map
map.description: Allows you to choose your destination at a crossroads.

ivScanner.name: IV Scanner
ivScanner.description: Enables scanning the IVs of wild Pokémon.

lockCapsule.name: Lock Capsule
lockCapsule.description: Allows you to lock item rarities when rerolling items.

teraOrb.name: Tera Orb
teraOrb.description: Allows your Pokémon to Terastallize. Recharges slowly. Tera Shards also become available.

goldenPokeball.name: Golden Poké Ball
goldenPokeball.description: Adds {{count}} extra item option at the end of every battle.

ovalCharm.name: Oval Charm
ovalCharm.description: When multiple Pokémon participate in a battle, each gets an extra {{boostPercent}}% of the total EXP.

expShare.name: EXP. All
expShare.description: Non-participants receive {{sharePercent}}% of a single participant’s EXP. Points.

expBalance.name: EXP. Balance
expBalance.description: Weighs EXP. Points received from battles towards lower-leveled party members.

candyJar.name: Candy Jar
candyJar.description: Increases the number of levels added by Rare Candy items by {{levels}}.

berryPouch.name: Berry Pouch
berryPouch.description: Adds a {{chancePercent}}% chance that a used berry will not be consumed.

healingCharm.name: Healing Charm
healingCharm.description: Increases the effectiveness of HP restoring moves and items by {{boostPercent}}% (excludes Revives).

abilityCharm.name: Ability Charm
abilityCharm.description: Dramatically increases the chance of a wild Pokémon having a Hidden Ability.

shinyCharm.name: Shiny Charm
shinyCharm.description: Dramatically increases the chance of a wild Pokémon being Shiny.

catchingCharm.name: Catching Charm
catchingCharm.description: Increases the chance of getting a critical catch.

blackSludge.name: Black Sludge
blackSludge.description: The stench is so powerful that shops will only sell you items at a steep cost increase.

goldenBugNet.name: Golden Bug Net
goldenBugNet.description: Imbues the owner with luck to find Bug Type Pokémon more often. Has a strange heft to it.

direHit.name: Dire Hit
direHit.description: Increases the {{stat}} of all party members by {{stages}} stage for up to {{battleCount}} battles.

enemyHeal.name: Recovery Token
enemyHeal.description: Heals {{healPercent}}% of max HP every turn.

enemyStatusEffectHealChance.name: Full Heal Token
enemyStatusEffectHealChance.description: Adds a {{chancePercent}}% chance every turn to heal a status condition.

enemyEndureChance.name: Endure Token
enemyEndureChance.description: Adds a {{chancePercent}}% chance of enduring a hit.

enemyFusedChance.name: Fusion Token
enemyFusedChance.description: Adds a {{chancePercent}}% chance that a wild Pokémon will be a fusion.

formChange.description: Causes certain Pokémon to change form.

typeAttackBooster.description: Increases the power of a Pokémon’s {{type}}-type moves by {{boostPercent}}%.

pokemonExpBooster.description: Increases the holder’s gain of EXP. Points by {{boostPercent}}%.

vitamin.description: Increases the holder’s base {{stat}} by {{boostPercent}}%. The higher your IVs, the higher the stack limit.

expBooster.description: Increases gain of EXP. Points by {{boostPercent}}%.

doubleBattleChanceBooster.description: Quadruples the chance of an encounter being a double battle for up to {{battleCount}} battles.

tempStatStageBooster.description: Increases the {{stat}} of all party members by {{boostPercent}}% for up to {{battleCount}} battles.

enemyAttackStatusEffectChance.description: Adds a {{chancePercent}}% chance to inflict {{statusEffect}} with attack moves.
